_doc: Occasion presets: what to send for a calendar, product or relationship moment, and the five lifecycle flows. skeleton = block types in order (build.py --scaffold expands them). needs = facts that must exist before the email can be built; without them pick the no_offer_skeleton or skip the occasion. Flows follow the flow study timings; calendar moments follow the anatomy study openers. popup = matching data/popups.json preset.

bfcm.name: Black Friday / Cyber Monday
bfcm.when: Teaser 3-5 days before, launch on the day, reminder +2 days, last call on Cyber Monday evening
bfcm.angle: State the offer plainly in the opener and the subject; the second block proves what it buys. Brands that do not discount send a values or bestseller email instead.
bfcm.sensitivity: Deadlines must be real; no fake countdowns. Suppress recent purchasers from the last call.

holiday-gift-guide.name: Holiday gift guide
holiday-gift-guide.when: Mid November to mid December, 1-2 sends
holiday-gift-guide.angle: Organize by recipient or price band; every tile links to a real collection.
subjects: Gifts for everyone on your list
holiday-gift-guide.sensitivity: Holiday names only if the brand uses them; shipping cutoffs only as published.

last-shipping-day.name: Last day to ship for the holidays
last-shipping-day.angle: One fact: the cutoff. Then the easiest gifts. Gift cards as the after-cutoff fallback if the brand sells them.
last-shipping-day.sensitivity: Use the carrier cutoff the site states; never estimate.

new-year.name: New year
new-year.angle: A routine or a fresh start the product genuinely supports; no resolution shaming.
new-year.sensitivity: Health and weight claims follow the niche compliance column.

valentines.name: Valentine's Day
valentines.when: 2 weeks before, plus a last-shipping reminder
valentines.angle: Gifting for partners, friends and yourself; keep it warm, not saccharine.
subjects: For the one you love (or yourself)
valentines.sensitivity: Offer an opt-out from Valentine's emails a week before; not everyone celebrates.

mothers-day.name: Mother's Day
mothers-day.when: 2 weeks before (dates differ by country), opt-out email 3 weeks before
mothers-day.angle: Gifts for mothers and mother figures; a gentle, inclusive tone.
subjects: Gifts for the people who raised you
mothers-day.sensitivity: Send an opt-out email first (a preferences link to skip Mother's Day messages) and suppress opted-out profiles.

fathers-day.name: Father's Day
fathers-day.when: 2 weeks before, opt-out email 3 weeks before
fathers-day.angle: Gifts for fathers and father figures; practical, specific.
fathers-day.sensitivity: Same opt-out practice as Mother's Day.

summer-sale.name: Summer or seasonal sale
summer-sale.angle: Offer first, then what it buys; end on a trust row.

brand-anniversary.name: Brand anniversary or birthday
needs: the founding year or milestone, as the brand states it
brand-anniversary.angle: Look back with real numbers and a founder note; a thank-you offer only if real.

launch.name: New product launch
launch.when: Teaser (optional) then launch day; follow-up +3 days to non-openers
needs: the product, price and launch date
launch.angle: Image opener, then why it exists (Anatomy study: image, story, products 1.7x). No discount on launch.

back-in-stock.name: Back in stock
back-in-stock.when: The day stock returns; Klaviyo's back-in-stock flow handles per-product subscribers
needs: the product and that it is in stock now
back-in-stock.angle: State it is back; one reason it sold out, only if sourced.
back-in-stock.sensitivity: No invented stock counts; 'limited' only if the site says so.

vip-early-access.name: VIP or early access
vip-early-access.when: 24-48 hours before public launch or sale
vip-early-access.angle: Make them feel early, not sold to; name the window.
subjects: You are early: <thing> opens for you today
vip-early-access.sensitivity: Send only to the qualifying segment.

bestsellers.name: Bestsellers
needs: which products are bestsellers, as the brand states it
bestsellers.angle: Lead with what others buy; real reviews only.

birthday.name: Customer birthday
birthday.when: Date-property flow on the birthday (collect it with the birthday-capture form)
needs: a birthday property on the profile
a real birthday gift or offer
birthday.angle: Short and warm; the gift is the email.
birthday.sensitivity: Never ask for the year if it is not needed.

review-request.name: Review request
review-request.angle: Ask plainly; say 'tap a star' only if each star links to a rating.
review-request.sensitivity: No incentive for positive reviews only.

referral.name: Refer a friend
referral.when: After a second purchase or a high review
needs: the real referral reward and terms
referral.angle: What both people get, in three steps.
referral.sensitivity: Reward terms exactly as the program states.

welcome.name: Welcome series
welcome.trigger: Joins the newsletter list (via the welcome popup)

emails.job: Welcome; first products, or offer plus code box when a real welcome offer exists
What makes it different
The collection
Proof (real reviews only)

abandoned-checkout.name: Abandoned checkout
abandoned-checkout.trigger: Started Checkout; exit on Placed Order

emails.job: Light reminder, exact cart, no discount
Objections: quality, warranty, returns
Alternatives
Final nudge; incentive only if approved, with a real deadline

browse-abandonment.name: Browse abandonment
browse-abandonment.trigger: Viewed Product; exit on Started Checkout or Placed Order

emails.job: The exact product viewed, no discount
Why it is worth it, two alternatives
Remove friction: shipping, returns, best sellers
Thank you and what happens next
Care or use guide, no selling
Review request
Pairs well with
A reason to come back

winback.name: Winback
winback.trigger: Segment: 1+ orders, none in 120 days (check the median reorder time)

emails.job: We miss you; what is new; no discount
What held you back
A reason to return (offer only if approved)
Last call tied to the real offer
Should we stay in touch (unengaged only; cta to the preferences page)
